g.text: 1. multiple levels, each level with a certain number of parking spots.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. types of vehicles, such as cars, motorcycles, and trucks.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Each parking spot should be able to accommodate a specific type of vehicle.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. The system should assign a parking spot to a vehicle upon entry and release it when the vehicle exits.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. The system should track the availability of parking spots and provide real-time information to customers.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. The system should handle multiple entry and exit points and support concurrent access.
